name: @builderforce/interaction-contract
description: The interaction contract shared by the QA telemetry, the session-replay recorder, the API ingest and the Insights views: the ONE selector derivation, input redaction, frustration detectors, the filter registry, smart-event rules, the release fingerprint and the replay chunk shape. Pure TypeScript with no DOM globals at module scope and no dependencies, so the recorder bundle stays small. Source-only: every consumer aliases the bare specifier straight at src/index.ts.
